tex.original: \hP{וַיַּעַל הַנֵּרֹת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃
verses.english: And he set the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting in front of the pavilion,

tex.original: \hP{וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מִזְבַּח הַזָּהָב בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת׃}

verses.original: וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: and he burned the incense of fragrances on it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּקְטֵר עָלָיו קְטֹרֶת סַמִּים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃
verses.english: And he set the cover of the entrance of the Tabernacle.

tex.original: \hP{וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת מָסַךְ הַפֶּתַח לַמִּשְׁכָּן׃}
tex.english: \eP{And he set the cover of the entrance of the Tabernacle.}

verses.original: וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה שָׂם פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעַל עָלָיו אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: And he set the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of Tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and he offered up the burnt offering and the grain offering on it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֵת מִזְבַּח הָעֹלָה שָׂם פֶּתַח מִשְׁכַּן אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַיַּעַל עָלָיו אֶת הָעֹלָה וְאֶת הַמִּנְחָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרחְצָה׃
verses.english: And he set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and he put water for washing there.

tex.original: \hP{וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַכִּיֹּר בֵּין אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן שָׁמָּה מַיִם לְרחְצָה׃}

verses.original: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet from it.

tex.original: \hP{וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת רַגְלֵיהֶם׃}

verses.original: בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבְקרְבָתָם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יִרְחָצוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: When they came to the Tent of Meeting and when they came forward to the altar they would wash, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{בְּבֹאָם אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבְקרְבָתָם אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ יִרְחָצוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיָּקֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה׃
verses.english: And he set up the courtyard all around the Tabernacle and the altar, and he put on the cover of the courtyard’s gate. And Moses finished the work.

tex.original: \hP{וַיָּקֶם אֶת הֶחָצֵר סָבִיב לַמִּשְׁכָּן וְלַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיִּתֵּן אֶת מָסַךְ שַׁעַר הֶחָצֵר וַיְכַל מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַמְּלָאכָה׃}

verses.original: וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃
verses.english: And the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and YHWH’s glory filled the Tabernacle.

tex.original: \hP{וַיְכַס הֶעָנָן אֶת אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃}

verses.original: וְלֹא יָכֹל מֹשֶׁה לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּי שָׁכַן עָלָיו הֶעָנָן וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃
verses.english: And Moses was not able to come into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud had settled on it and YHWH’s glory filled the Tabernacle.

tex.original: \hP{וְלֹא יָכֹל מֹשֶׁה לָבוֹא אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד כִּי שָׁכַן עָלָיו הֶעָנָן וּכְבוֹד יְהֹוָה מָלֵא אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן׃}

verses.original: וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: And when the cloud was lifted from on the Tabernacle, the children of Israel would travel—in all their travels—

tex.original: \hP{וּבְהֵעָלוֹת הֶעָנָן מֵעַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יִסְעוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכֹל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃}

verses.original: וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: and if the cloud would not be lifted, then they would not travel until the day that it would be lifted.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם לֹא יֵעָלֶה הֶעָנָן וְלֹא יִסְעוּ עַד יוֹם הֵעָלֹתוֹ׃}

verses.original: כִּי עֲנַן יְהֹוָה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Because YHWH’s cloud was on the Tabernacle by day, and fire would be in it at night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel in all their travels.

tex.original: \hP{כִּי עֲנַן יְהֹוָה עַל הַמִּשְׁכָּן יוֹמָם וְאֵשׁ תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה בּוֹ לְעֵינֵי כל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכל מַסְעֵיהֶם׃}

verses.commentary:
Here we have the first ever fragment of the JHWH and Mösen Apocryphon yet excavated.

Sadly for the curious layperson, the screenplay is a bit heavy of mouth and tongue. [That is, a foreign film.]

Namely, when the original Nameless text was originally discovered, we believed it to have been composed entirely in an odd dialect of German. The plot seemed to be a story in which YHWH is looking for Moses, and cannot find him, as can be seen here:

Möse. Wo sie Möse? Wer hat Möse? Wer bin? Ich bin! Jahwe. Jah, wir. Wir war, Jah [wirr, warr]. Mein גר man ist sehr שער, sehr אדם, sehr männ, sehr wirr. Est vir verus. Wir werus. Yah [wirr]. Wo ist Mösen? Wo bist du? Aha, Mösen! Warum rennst du?... Lauf nicht. Wen? Die Mösen!? Warum nicht? Wir esse Mösen. Wer bin? Mein Gott. Du Göttin, dich. Gib mir das Möse holen. Komm her, Baby. Sie, mein wenig? Sie mein ekliges Ding. Ich liebe Dich. Dich und Möse. Wo sie ich? Dieses Buch. Gutes Buch. Wen? Eure? Seir seir seir gut. Wen Möse die? Nicht lassen. War? Ich werde bund tun. Komm mit dich babe. Du komm bald? Ich komm bald. Dei Möse ist mein, babe. Dei Möse ist mein für immer. Für immer und immer Moses. Für immer und immer. Nur du und ich.

Since “losing track of someone” is a common theme in YHWH related stories (history or narrative) of all forms, the assumption that we'd understood the text went unchallenged for some time.

However, a breakthrough came recently when an anonymous individual calling himself “Adam Ben Ben Ben Möses” (sic?) made an anonymous post on a forum of Nameless Studies on the The Dynamic Read-Writable Free Encyclopedic Repository of the Modern State of Human Knowledge.

No claim is made as to the complete accuracy of the translation, but we believe it is roughly accurate in most details.

Whatever imperfections might remain, the text does appear to read as two completely different scenes in two different languages: a criterion now understood — thanks to recent advances in Nameless Studies — to be a requirement for all authentic texts written by “the hand of god,” or by the authentic sect of its nameless authors.

The biblically knowledgeable reader will likely recognize a similarity to Exodus 4's notoriously difficult “Lodging Place” scene, specifically where the text below reads “Die Mösen” and later in the same passage, “Wen Möses die?”

The scholarly community is just coming to grips with the possibility that all ancient texts previously attributed to a god or gods appear to share the “dual reading” property.

This suggests that the above mentioned section of Exodus 4 may have simply been a result of the deity (or the author (or both)) making a series of crude plays on words, in multiple languages and language families, and that the original text may have been not far from the fragment below.

Just a final note: the text that follows is not appropriate for children, so please do make sure to put the kids to bed before reading any further. Thank you for reading, and we hope you find the text to be clarifying of whatever relationship you may have with the Lord, or perhaps clarifying of any of the topics discussed directly in the body of the text... if you're into that sort of thing. We now proceed with the text.

Moses. Where is Moses? Who has Moses? Who am I? I am! Yahweh. Yah, we. We were, Yah [confused, chaos]. My foreign [Lit. My Ger man. From Heb. גר, meaning foreign.] man is very hairy, very human, very male, very chaotic. He is a true man. We are true. Yah [confused]. Where are Moses? Where are you? Aha, Moses! Why are you running?... Don't run. Who? The Moses!? Why not? We eat Moses. Who am I? My God. You goddess, you. Let me get that Moses. Come here, baby. You, my little one? You, my nasty thing. I love you. You and Moses. Where am I? This book. Good book. Whose? Yours? So, so, so good. Whose Moses is it? Don't let go. What? I'm going to do it. Come with me, babe. You coming soon? I'm coming soon. Your Moses is mine, babe. Your Moses is mine forever. Forever and ever, Moses. Forever and ever. Just you and me. Featuring: JHWH and The Ten Things You Müsen Do... The Ten Kommand Möse!The surviving publicity material supplies rather more working titles than the upcoming film can reasonably use. A few representative proposals, with their accompanying English renderings, are Titel: Schadei nist Gott (“Title: Shaddai is God”), Titel: Schade ist Gott (“Title: God Is a Pity”), and Titel: Schaden ist Gott (“Title: Harm is God”). The running joke is a divine name, Shaddai, coming uncomfortably close to Schade (“a pity”) and Schaden (“harm”): a small revision to the title can turn a profession of faith into a complaint. These are the publicity department's proposed readings; the reader need not accept its German to appreciate its theological difficulties. Its final proposal, Gott's Tit ist El Schadden, arrives in English as “God's title is El Shaddai.” The English has discreetly restored the missing letters in “title” before anyone can ask about the deity's anatomy.

The ten girls fare little better in the cast list. Their collective billing appears as Die Zehn Kommende Mädchen!, rendered “The Ten Girls Who Are Coming!”, and as The 10 Kommend Mösen, rendered “The 10 Coming Pussies”. No individual character names survive in these notices. The advertised “Ten Kommand Möse” thus lets the Ten Commandments take the stage as ten women: Möse supplies the vulgar anatomical sense, while “coming” leaves their entrance open to interpretation. The publicity department assures us that all ten will come.

Post Script. We apologize on behalf of the scholarly community for whatever effect this might have had on the reader's relationship with the Lord.

%		are seven chapters of prescription. This is consistent with a theme of

Grain offering on griddle, very simple.

Break into pieces and drizzle more oil.

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מֵאֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִגִּישָׁהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: “And you shall bring the grain offering that one will make from these things to YHWH, and one shall bring it forward to the priest, and he shall bring it over to the altar.
verses.commentary:
Bring to YHWH.

That means give to priest. Priest bring to altar.

Don't just walk up to altar yourself. This is Tent of Meeting. היה.

tex.original: \hP{וְהֵבֵאתָ אֶת הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂה מֵאֵלֶּה לַיהֹוָה וְהִקְרִיבָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִגִּישָׁהּ אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃}

verses.original: וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: And the priest shall lift from the grain offering a representative portion of it and burn it to smoke at the altar, an offering by fire of a pleasant smell to YHWH.
verses.commentary:
Priest take some and burn on altar.

Good smell for YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{וְהֵרִים הַכֹּהֵן מִן הַמִּנְחָה אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֵּׁה רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃
verses.english: And the remainder from the grain offering is Aaron’s and his sons’, the holy of holies from YHWH’s offerings by fire.
verses.commentary:
Leftover for Aaron son.

Holy of holy from YHWH.

יהי.

tex.original: \hP{וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִן הַמִּנְחָה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: כּל הַמִּנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה לֹא תֵעָשֶׂה חָמֵץ כִּי כל שְׂאֹר וְכל דְּבַשׁ לֹא תַקְטִירוּ מִמֶּנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: Every grain offering that you will bring forward to YHWH shall not be made with leavening, because all leaven and all honey: you shall not burn any of it to smoke as an offering by fire to YHWH.
verses.commentary:
No yeast.

No honey on altar.

Who put honey on altar?

היה.

verses.original: קרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ׃
verses.english: You shall bring them forward to YHWH as an offering of a first thing, but they shall not go up to the altar as a pleasant smell.
verses.commentary:
Bring to YHWH.

First thing of harvest.

Don't burn it.

This not for smell.

tex.original: \hP{קרְבַּן רֵאשִׁית תַּקְרִיבוּ אֹתָם לַיהֹוָה וְאֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא יַעֲלוּ לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ׃}

verses.original: וְכל קרְבַּן מִנְחָתְךָ בַּמֶּלַח תִּמְלָח וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּית מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעַל מִנְחָתֶךָ עַל כּל קרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח׃
verses.english: And you shall sprinkle every offering of a grain offering with salt. And you shall not let the salt of your God’s covenant cease from on your grain offering; you shall bring salt on all your offerings.
verses.commentary:
Put salt on offering. Food need seasoning.

Covenant say salt. YHWH know seasoning.

Imagine YHWH make universe and you bring him bland cracker. היה.

tex.original: \hP{וְכל קרְבַּן מִנְחָתְךָ בַּמֶּלַח תִּמְלָח וְלֹא תַשְׁבִּית מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵעַל מִנְחָתֶךָ עַל כּל קרְבָּנְךָ תַּקְרִיב מֶלַח׃}

verses.english: “And if you will bring a grain offering of firstfruits to YHWH, you shall bring the grain offering of your firstfruits ripe, parched with fire, groats of fresh grain.
verses.commentary:
First grain of harvest. Very fancy.

Cook over fire. If grain still pale, what you doing?

היה.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם תַּקְרִיב מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרִים לַיהֹוָה אָבִיב קָלוּי בָּאֵשׁ גֶּרֶשׂ כַּרְמֶל תַּקְרִיב אֵת מִנְחַת בִּכּוּרֶיךָ׃}

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְשַׂמְתָּ עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה מִנְחָה הִוא׃
verses.english: And you shall put oil on it and set frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.
verses.commentary:
Put oil on it.

Then frankincense okay.

It is grain offering.

verses.original: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ מִגִּרְשָׂהּ וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ עַל כּל לְבֹנָתָהּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה׃

verses.commentary:
Now priest burn some of fried grain offering.

Some oil and all frankincense.

Nobody eat incense.

How many time I have to tell you.

Who put incense in rice?

For love of YHWH. [Lit. 愛 יה in the original text.]

verses.english: “And if his offering is a peace-offering sacrifice, if he is offering from the herd, whether male or female, he shall make it unblemished in front of YHWH.
verses.commentary:
Giving thanks, but what's for dinner?

Cow or bull, either's fine.

But unblemished, you donkey. Bring YHWH a proper one.

verses.english: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting. And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall fling the blood on the altar all around.
verses.commentary:
All meat goes to the Meetin' Tent.

Hand on its head.

Slaughter it up nice.

Then the lads go bloody wild, just flingin' it all around.

Both kidneys, the fat round the bits, and the bit off the liver.

tex.original: \hP{דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא בִשְׁגָגָה מִכֹּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְעָשָׂה מֵאַחַת מֵהֵנָּה׃}
tex.commentary:
Go tell the people that if you sin by mistake—doing anything you're
	not supposed to—and you do any one of them:
%	\footnote{
%		A person who sins. At the time that I am writing this, it has been
%		almost two thousand years since the second Jerusalem Temple was
%		destroyed and sacrifices ended in Judaism. The two largest religions,
%		Christianity and Islam, also do not perform sacrifices, and so it has
%		been so long since we have seen or done this practice that all but a few
%		people are unclear about what sacrifice was. Frequently they imagine
%		that it meant that people regularly destroyed much of their livestock
%		for no reason. This is wrong. The purpose of sacrifice was to recognize
%		that an animal’s life was sacred. The order of the book of Leviticus
%		itself may have contributed to the misunderstanding of sacrifice. It
%		deals with the sacrifices that go to the priests first (in Leviticus
%		1–7) and does not get to the “food” sacrifices until Leviticus 17. Most
%		sacrificed animals are eaten by the persons who bring the animals to the
%		altar. There is also a second group of sacrifices, which involve the
%		ritual slaughter of an animal that is not for consumption by the person
%		who brings the sacrifice. Rather, the meat is eaten by the priests or is
%		entirely burnt. Such sacrifices relate to guilt and expiation. The
%		introduction of law means the introduction of violations of the law.
%		Besides addressing matters of punishment (compensation, execution), the
%		system requires some means of dealing with individuals’ feelings of
%		guilt—and with public condemnation. This is achieved through the
%		sacrificial system, including sacrifices for unwitting violations, by
%		individuals or the community (Leviticus 4 and 5), and sacrifices for
%		various other feelings on the part of the offerer (Leviticus 1–3). The
%		system that provides grounds for guilt also provides a mechanism for
%		expiation and forgiveness. Sacrifice is the only mechanism for
%		forgiveness in the book of Leviticus. There is no suggestion in
%		Leviticus that repentance alone can bring forgiveness for violations of
%		the laws, no indication that one can appeal to YHWH’s mercy, His grace,
%		or His kindness for atonement. Indeed, the words “repentance” (ûb),
%		“mercy” (ramîm), “grace” (n), and “kindness” (esed) do not occur in
%		Leviticus. Thus the psychological and spiritual state of the community
%		is linked powerfully to this visible, tangible act. And this
%		psychological and spiritual focus, together with the very physical focus
%		of the consumption of meat, places sacrifice in a critical and pervasive
%		role in the community’s life. And it places the priests who alone can
%		perform sacrifice in a correspondingly critical role. And, no less
%		significantly, it concentrates the community’s attention on the single
%		place where sacrifice can be performed: the Tabernacle, or Tent of
%		Meeting. Footnote 4:2. by mistake. This begins a lengthy section on what
%		to do when people sin by mistake: a priest, the entire community, a
%		leader, or an individual. Humans make mistakes. But even a sin that is
%		committed by mistake requires some act of atonement. People still feel
%		guilty when they do harm, even if they meant no harm, and so this
%		provides a mechanism for purging the guilt and putting the act in the
%		past. Now, in the absence of sacrifice, other means of atonement have
%		risen in importance. Notably, the Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur) has
%		become the most sacred and widely observed holiday; whereas, in the
%		Torah, Passover stands out as the first and foremost of the holidays.
%	}

verses.original: אִם הַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ יֶחֱטָא לְאַשְׁמַת הָעָם וְהִקְרִיב עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר תָּמִים לַיהֹוָה לְחַטָּאת׃
verses.english: “If the anointed priest will sin, causing the people’s guilt, then he shall bring forward for his sin that he committed: a bull of the cattle, unblemished, for YHWH as a sin offering.
verses.commentary: Case 1: If it's the oil-headed priests doing it, then he has to get a bull—a perfect one—for YHWH as a fine. REF: the anointed priest. Hebrew hakkhn hammîa. This is the first occurrence of the word mîa, meaning “anointed” and commonly translated elsewhere in the Tanak as “Messiah.” In the Torah mîa always refers to the high priest and not, as it later came to mean, the king. The relationship between priest and king was always a complex one in the Tanak and in the postbiblical world as well. The judge Gideon declines to be made Israel’s first king, but he acts as a priest, which may well have involved greater power, distinction, and income (Judg 8:22–27). David makes some of his sons priests (2Sam 8:18). The Hasmoneans (Maccabees) were initially high priests but later were simultaneously priests and kings.

verses.original: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְשָׁמְעָה קוֹל אָלָה וְהוּא עֵד אוֹ רָאָה אוֹ יָדָע אִם לוֹא יַגִּיד וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃
verses.english: “And a person who will sin in that he has heard a pronouncement of an oath, and he was a witness—whether he saw or he knew: if he will not tell, then he shall bear his crime.

tex.original: \hP{וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְשָׁמְעָה קוֹל אָלָה וְהוּא עֵד אוֹ רָאָה אוֹ יָדָע אִם לוֹא יַגִּיד וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃}
tex.commentary:
%	\footnote{
%		bear his crime. This expression means that the person is not punished by
%		a court. It is between the individual and God. After all, in this case,
%		it may be that no one but the person himself is even aware that he did
%		the sin. The reverse expression occurs in the great formula of God’s
%		compassion in Exod 34:7, where it says that God bears crime (ns’ ‘wn)
%		for humans. That very emphasis on the usual divine mercy makes cases
%		like the current one so frightening: here it is the human who must bear
%		the crime himself. This expression will be used in a number of cases in
%		Leviticus and Numbers. By saying that a case is beyond the jurisdiction
%		of any court or ruler, the Torah recognizes that some things are beyond
%		humans’ ability and humans’ right to judge or punish.
%	}

verses.original: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בְּכל דָּבָר טָמֵא אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיָּה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת שֶׁרֶץ טָמֵא וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא טָמֵא וְאָשֵׁם׃
verses.english: “Or a person who will touch any impure thing or the carcass of an impure wild animal or the carcass of an impure domestic animal or the carcass of an impure swarming creature, and it was hidden from him, so he had become impure and had become guilty;

tex.original: \hP{אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּגַּע בְּכל דָּבָר טָמֵא אוֹ בְנִבְלַת חַיָּה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת בְּהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּנִבְלַת שֶׁרֶץ טָמֵא וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא טָמֵא וְאָשֵׁם׃}

verses.original: אוֹ כִי יִגַּע בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא בָּהּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם׃
verses.english: or when he will touch a human’s impurity—for any impurity of his through which he will become impure—and it was hidden from him, and then he had come to know and had become guilty;

tex.original: \hP{אוֹ כִי יִגַּע בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם לְכֹל טֻמְאָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא בָּהּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם׃}

verses.original: אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִשָּׁבַע לְבַטֵּא בִשְׂפָתַיִם לְהָרַע אוֹ לְהֵיטִיב לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְבַטֵּא הָאָדָם בִּשְׁבֻעָה וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: or a person who will swear so as to let out of his lips to do bad or to do good—for anything that a human would let out in an oath—and it was hidden from him, and then he had come to know and had become guilty by one of these:

tex.original: \hP{אוֹ נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִשָּׁבַע לְבַטֵּא בִשְׂפָתַיִם לְהָרַע אוֹ לְהֵיטִיב לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יְבַטֵּא הָאָדָם בִּשְׁבֻעָה וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּנּוּ וְהוּא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה׃}

verses.original: וְהָיָה כִי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: And it will be that when he becomes guilty by one of these he shall confess that he has sinned over it,

tex.original: \hP{וְהָיָה כִי יֶאְשַׁם לְאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְהִתְוַדָּה אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עָלֶיהָ׃}

verses.original: וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא נְקֵבָה מִן הַצֹּאן כִּשְׂבָּה אוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ׃
verses.english: and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH over his sin that he has committed: a female from the flock, a sheep or a goat, as a sin offering, and the priest shall make atonement over him from his sin.

tex.original: \hP{וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא נְקֵבָה מִן הַצֹּאן כִּשְׂבָּה אוֹ שְׂעִירַת עִזִּים לְחַטָּאת וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ׃}

verses.original: וְאִם לֹא תַגִּיעַ יָדוֹ דֵּי שֶׂה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃
verses.english: “And if his hand will not attain enough for a sheep, then he shall bring as his guilt offering for having sinned two turtledoves or two pigeons to YHWH: one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם לֹא תַגִּיעַ יָדוֹ דֵּי שֶׂה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא שְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ שְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה לַיהֹוָה אֶחָד לְחַטָּאת וְאֶחָד לְעֹלָה׃}

verses.original: וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִקְרִיב אֶת אֲשֶׁר לַחַטָּאת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ מִמּוּל ערְפּוֹ וְלֹא יַבְדִּיל׃
verses.english: And he shall bring them to the priest, and he shall bring forward the one that is for the sin offering first and will wring but not separate its head at the point opposite its neck.

tex.original: \hP{וְהֵבִיא אֹתָם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְהִקְרִיב אֶת אֲשֶׁר לַחַטָּאת רִאשׁוֹנָה וּמָלַק אֶת רֹאשׁוֹ מִמּוּל ערְפּוֹ וְלֹא יַבְדִּיל׃}

verses.original: וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הוּא׃
verses.english: And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the wall of the altar, and what remains of the blood shall be drained at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

tex.original: \hP{וְהִזָּה מִדַּם הַחַטָּאת עַל קִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְהַנִּשְׁאָר בַּדָּם יִמָּצֵה אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ חַטָּאת הוּא׃}

verses.original: וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃
verses.english: And he shall make the second one a burnt offering according to the required manner. And the priest shall make atonement over him from his sin that he committed, and it shall be forgiven for him.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֶת הַשֵּׁנִי יַעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה כַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן מֵחַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃}

verses.original: וְאִם לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ לִשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ לִשְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת לְחַטָּאת לֹא יָשִׂים עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה כִּי חַטָּאת הִוא׃
verses.english: “And if his hand cannot attain enough for two turtledoves or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for having sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall not set oil on it, and he shall not put frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
verses.commentary: I have a question about the two turtledoves.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם לֹא תַשִּׂיג יָדוֹ לִשְׁתֵּי תֹרִים אוֹ לִשְׁנֵי בְנֵי יוֹנָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת לְחַטָּאת לֹא יָשִׂים עָלֶיהָ שֶׁמֶן וְלֹא יִתֵּן עָלֶיהָ לְבֹנָה כִּי חַטָּאת הִוא׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		“And if his hand cannot attain enough for two turtledoves
		or two pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for
		having sinned a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin
		offering. He shall not set oil on it, and he shall not put
		frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
	}
tex.commentary: \aB{I have a question about the two turtledoves.}

verses.original: וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הִוא׃
verses.english: And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take the fill of his fist from it, a representative portion of it, and he shall burn it to smoke at the altar with YHWH’s offerings by fire. It is a sin offering.

tex.original: \hP{וֶהֱבִיאָהּ אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְקָמַץ הַכֹּהֵן מִמֶּנָּה מְלוֹא קֻמְצוֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָהּ וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה חַטָּאת הִוא׃}

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מֵאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ וְהָיְתָה לַכֹּהֵן כַּמִּנְחָה׃
verses.english: And the priest shall make atonement over him, over his sin that he committed, from one of these, and it shall be forgiven for him. And it shall be the priest’s, like the grain offering.”

tex.original: \hP{וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מֵאַחַת מֵאֵלֶּה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ וְהָיְתָה לַכֹּהֵן כַּמִּנְחָה׃}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִמְעֹל מַעַל וְחָטְאָה בִּשְׁגָגָה מִקּדְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאָשָׁם׃
verses.english: “A person who will make a breach and sin by mistake among YHWH’s holy things: he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH, an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation of silver by shekels, by the shekel of the Holy, as a guilt offering.

tex.original: \hP{נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִמְעֹל מַעַל וְחָטְאָה בִּשְׁגָגָה מִקּדְשֵׁי יְהֹוָה וְהֵבִיא אֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ כֶּסֶף שְׁקָלִים בְּשֶׁקֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ לְאָשָׁם׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		“A person who will make a breach and sin by mistake among
		YHWH’s holy things: he shall bring his guilt offering to
		YHWH, an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation
		of silver by shekels, by the shekel of the Holy, as a
		guilt offering.
	}
tex.commentary:
%	\footnote{
%		make a breach. The term, Hebrew ma‘al, refers to trespassing into a zone
%		that is forbidden. Here it refers to a layperson’s mistakenly taking
%		some of the holy objects, something that is no longer available, which
%		would in most cases mean food that was meant for the priests. (Lev
%		22:14–16 refers explicitly to a layperson mistakenly eating the holy
%		things, and the penalty is the same: add a fifth.) In Joshua 7:1, this
%		term, “breach,” refers to Achan’s taking some of the spoils of Jericho,
%		which the Israelites had been forbidden to take under the law of erem
%		(complete destruction in wars commanded by God; see, e.g., Deut 13:18).
%		In Num 5:6, it refers to unlawful acquisition of another person’s
%		property. In Num 5:12, a woman’s adultery is referred to as a ma‘al
%		against her husband. In Lev 26:40, it refers generally to a breach of
%		faith toward God by the community.
%	}

verses.original: וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם וְאֶת חֲמִישִׁתוֹ יוֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן אֹתוֹ לַכֹּהֵן וְהַכֹּהֵן יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃
verses.english: And for what he sinned from the Holy he shall pay and add to it a fifth of it and give it to the priest, and the priest shall make atonement over him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it shall be forgiven for him.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר חָטָא מִן הַקֹּדֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּם וְאֶת חֲמִישִׁתוֹ יוֹסֵף עָלָיו וְנָתַן אֹתוֹ לַכֹּהֵן וְהַכֹּהֵן יְכַפֵּר עָלָיו בְּאֵיל הָאָשָׁם וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃}

verses.original: וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְעָשְׂתָה אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃
verses.english: “And if a person who will sin and commit one of any of YHWH’s commandments that are not to be done and did not know and became guilty, then he shall bear his crime.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וְעָשְׂתָה אַחַת מִכּל מִצְוֺת יְהֹוָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂינָה וְלֹא יָדַע וְאָשֵׁם וְנָשָׂא עֲוֺנוֹ׃}

verses.original: וְהֵבִיא אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ לְאָשָׁם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל שִׁגְגָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגָג וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃
verses.english: And he shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation as a guilt offering to the priest, and the priest shall make atonement over him, over his mistake that he made and had not known, and it shall be forgiven for him.

tex.original: \hP{וְהֵבִיא אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ לְאָשָׁם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן עַל שִׁגְגָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגָג וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע וְנִסְלַח לוֹ׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		And he shall bring an unblemished ram from the flock by
		your evaluation as a guilt offering to the priest, and the
		priest shall make atonement over him, over his mistake
		that he made and had not known, and it shall be forgiven
		for him.
	}

verses.original: אָשָׁם הוּא אָשֹׁם אָשַׁם לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: It is a guilt offering. He is guilty to YHWH.”

tex.original: \hP{אָשָׁם הוּא אָשֹׁם אָשַׁם לַיהֹוָה׃}
tex.english: \eP{It is a guilt offering. He is guilty to YHWH.”}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וּמָעֲלָה מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה וְכִחֵשׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ בְּפִקָּדוֹן אוֹ בִתְשׂוּמֶת יָד אוֹ בְגָזֵל אוֹ עָשַׁק אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: “A person who will sin and make a breach against YHWH and tell a lie against his fellow in a matter of a deposit or something set in hand or by robbery, or has exploited his fellow

tex.original: \hP{נֶפֶשׁ כִּי תֶחֱטָא וּמָעֲלָה מַעַל בַּיהֹוָה וְכִחֵשׁ בַּעֲמִיתוֹ בְּפִקָּדוֹן אוֹ בִתְשׂוּמֶת יָד אוֹ בְגָזֵל אוֹ עָשַׁק אֶת עֲמִיתוֹ׃}

verses.original: אוֹ מָצָא אֲבֵדָה וְכִחֶשׁ בָּהּ וְנִשְׁבַּע עַל שָׁקֶר עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָאָדָם לַחֲטֹא בָהֵנָּה׃
verses.english: or has found something that was lost and has lied about it or sworn to a falsehood—for one of any of these that a human will do to sin:

tex.original: \hP{אוֹ מָצָא אֲבֵדָה וְכִחֶשׁ בָּהּ וְנִשְׁבַּע עַל שָׁקֶר עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה הָאָדָם לַחֲטֹא בָהֵנָּה׃}

verses.original: וְהָיָה כִּי יֶחֱטָא וְאָשֵׁם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הַגְּזֵלָה אֲשֶׁר גָּזָל אוֹ אֶת הָעֹשֶׁק אֲשֶׁר עָשָׁק אוֹ אֶת הַפִּקָּדוֹן אֲשֶׁר הפְקַד אִתּוֹ אוֹ אֶת הָאֲבֵדָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא׃
verses.english: it will be, when he sins and is guilty, that he shall bring back the thing that he robbed or the thing that he coerced or the thing that was deposited with him or the lost thing that he found

tex.original: \hP{וְהָיָה כִּי יֶחֱטָא וְאָשֵׁם וְהֵשִׁיב אֶת הַגְּזֵלָה אֲשֶׁר גָּזָל אוֹ אֶת הָעֹשֶׁק אֲשֶׁר עָשָׁק אוֹ אֶת הַפִּקָּדוֹן אֲשֶׁר הפְקַד אִתּוֹ אוֹ אֶת הָאֲבֵדָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא׃}

verses.original: אוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁבַע עָלָיו לַשֶּׁקֶר וְשִׁלַּם אֹתוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וַחֲמִשִׁתָיו יֹסֵף עָלָיו לַאֲשֶׁר הוּא לוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ בְּיוֹם אַשְׁמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: or anything about which he swore as a falsehood, and he shall pay it in its worth and add to it a fifth of it. He shall give it to the one whose it is on the day of his being guilty,

tex.original: \hP{אוֹ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׁבַע עָלָיו לַשֶּׁקֶר וְשִׁלַּם אֹתוֹ בְּרֹאשׁוֹ וַחֲמִשִׁתָיו יֹסֵף עָלָיו לַאֲשֶׁר הוּא לוֹ יִתְּנֶנּוּ בְּיוֹם אַשְׁמָתוֹ׃}

verses.original: וְאֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ יָבִיא לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ לְאָשָׁם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃
verses.english: and he shall bring his guilt offering to YHWH: an unblemished ram from the flock by your evaluation as a guilt offering, to the priest.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֶת אֲשָׁמוֹ יָבִיא לַיהֹוָה אַיִל תָּמִים מִן הַצֹּאן בְּעֶרְכְּךָ לְאָשָׁם אֶל הַכֹּהֵן׃}

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה לְאַשְׁמָה בָהּ׃
verses.english: And the priest shall atone over him in front of YHWH, and it will be forgiven for him, for any one out of all that he will do to become guilty through it.”

tex.original: \hP{וְכִפֶּר עָלָיו הַכֹּהֵן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה וְנִסְלַח לוֹ עַל אַחַת מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה לְאַשְׁמָה בָהּ׃}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: צַו אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הָעֹלָה הִוא הָעֹלָה עַל מוֹקְדָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כּל הַלַּיְלָה עַד הַבֹּקֶר וְאֵשׁ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ׃
verses.english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the instruction for the burnt offering. It is the one that goes up on its place of burning on the altar all night until morning, and the altar’s fire shall be kept burning through it.

tex.original: \hP{צַו אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הָעֹלָה הִוא הָעֹלָה עַל מוֹקְדָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ כּל הַלַּיְלָה עַד הַבֹּקֶר וְאֵשׁ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		“Command Aaron and his sons, saying: This is the
		instruction for the burnt offering. It is the one that
		goes up on its place of burning on the altar all night
		until morning, and the altar’s fire shall be kept burning
		through it.
	}

verses.original: וְלָבַשׁ הַכֹּהֵן מִדּוֹ בַד וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִלְבַּשׁ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְהֵרִים אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל הָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעֹלָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׂמוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: And the priest shall wear his linen garment and shall wear linen drawers on his flesh. And he shall lift the ashes to which the fire will consume the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall set them beside the altar.

tex.original: \hP{וְלָבַשׁ הַכֹּהֵן מִדּוֹ בַד וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד יִלְבַּשׁ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ וְהֵרִים אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל הָאֵשׁ אֶת הָעֹלָה עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְשָׂמוֹ אֵצֶל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃}

verses.original: וּפָשַׁט אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְלָבַשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל מָקוֹם טָהוֹר׃
verses.english: And he shall take off his clothes and wear other clothes, and he shall take the ashes outside the camp, to a pure place.

tex.original: \hP{וּפָשַׁט אֶת בְּגָדָיו וְלָבַשׁ בְּגָדִים אֲחֵרִים וְהוֹצִיא אֶת הַדֶּשֶׁן אֶל מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה אֶל מָקוֹם טָהוֹר׃}
tex.commentary:
%	\footnote{
%		he shall take off his clothes and wear other clothes. The priest wears
%		the special priestly garments when he gathers the ashes in the
%		Tabernacle courtyard, but he changes to other clothes when he carries
%		the ashes out of the camp. Why? Because the sacred garments can be worn
%		only in the sacred place. This is another case of zones of holiness.
%	}

verses.original: וְהָאֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ לֹא תִכְבֶּה וּבִעֵר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן עֵצִים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶיהָ הָעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃
verses.english: And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning through it. It shall not go out. And the priest shall burn wood on it morning by morning, and he shall arrange the burnt offering on it, and he shall burn the fat of the peace offerings to smoke on it.

tex.original: \hP{וְהָאֵשׁ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ תּוּקַד בּוֹ לֹא תִכְבֶּה וּבִעֵר עָלֶיהָ הַכֹּהֵן עֵצִים בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר וְעָרַךְ עָלֶיהָ הָעֹלָה וְהִקְטִיר עָלֶיהָ חֶלְבֵי הַשְּׁלָמִים׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		And the fire on the altar shall be kept burning through
		it. It shall not go out. And the priest shall burn wood on
		it morning by morning, and he shall arrange the burnt
		offering on it, and he shall burn the fat of the peace
		offerings to smoke on it.
	}

verses.original: אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא תִכְבֶּה׃
verses.english: Fire always shall be kept burning on the altar. It shall not go out.

tex.original: \hP{אֵשׁ תָּמִיד תּוּקַד עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ לֹא תִכְבֶּה׃}
tex.commentary:
%	\footnote{
%		Fire always shall be kept burning on the altar. It shall not go out. If
%		it will always be kept burning, of course it will not go out. This is
%		redundant, and this makes it emphatic: this ritual law has special
%		significance because it brings together space and time. YHWH tells Moses
%		to command Aaron and his sons to keep an eternal fire burning at the
%		altar. This law thus provides for a visual expression of the idea that
%		the ritual structure that is starting here is to prevail for all time to
%		come. This fire that is not to be quenched is also reminiscent of the
%		account in Exodus of Moses’ encounter with YHWH at a bush that burns
%		without being consumed. Like the laws of distinction that are
%		reminiscent of the creation in Genesis 1 (see the comment on Lev 10:10),
%		this passage serves to connect the law and the Torah’s story. In both
%		cases, the priests are required by the law to perform an act that is
%		imitative of something that God has done in the narrative—which further
%		points to the bond between law and history in the Torah.
%	}

verses.original: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פְּנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: “And this is the instruction for the grain offering. The sons of Aaron shall bring it forward in front of YHWH to the front of the altar.

tex.original: \hP{וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הַמִּנְחָה הַקְרֵב אֹתָהּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה אֶל פְּנֵי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃}

verses.original: וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: And he shall lift some of it in his fist, some of the fine flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all of the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he shall burn a representative portion of it to smoke at the altar as a pleasant smell to YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{וְהֵרִים מִמֶּנּוּ בְּקֻמְצוֹ מִסֹּלֶת הַמִּנְחָה וּמִשַּׁמְנָהּ וְאֵת כּל הַלְּבֹנָה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַמִּנְחָה וְהִקְטִיר הַמִּזְבֵּחַ רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אַזְכָּרָתָהּ לַיהֹוָה׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		And he shall lift some of it in his fist, some of the fine
		flour of the grain offering and some of its oil and all of
		the frankincense that is on the grain offering, and he
		shall burn a representative portion of it to smoke at the
		altar as a pleasant smell to YHWH.
	}

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלוּהָ׃
verses.english: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the remainder of it. It shall be eaten as unleavened bread, in a holy place. They shall eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

tex.original: \hP{וְהַנּוֹתֶרֶת מִמֶּנָּה יֹאכְלוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו מַצּוֹת תֵּאָכֵל בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד יֹאכְלוּהָ׃}

verses.original: לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָׁם׃
verses.english: It shall not be baked with leaven. I have given it as their portion from my offerings by fire. It is the holy of holies, like the sin offering and like the guilt offering.

tex.original: \hP{לֹא תֵאָפֶה חָמֵץ חֶלְקָם נָתַתִּי אֹתָהּ מֵאִשָּׁי קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא כַּחַטָּאת וְכָאָשָׁם׃}

verses.original: כּל זָכָר בִּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן יֹאכְלֶנָּה חק עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃
verses.english: Every male among the sons of Aaron shall eat it—an eternal law through your generations—from YHWH’s offerings by fire. Anything that will touch them will become holy.”

tex.original: \hP{כּל זָכָר בִּבְנֵי אַהֲרֹן יֹאכְלֶנָּה חק עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בָּהֶם יִקְדָּשׁ׃}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: זֶה קרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת מִנְחָה תָּמִיד מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב׃
verses.english: “This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they shall bring to YHWH in the day of his being anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.

tex.original: \hP{זֶה קרְבַּן אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיבוּ לַיהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִמָּשַׁח אֹתוֹ עֲשִׂירִת הָאֵפָה סֹלֶת מִנְחָה תָּמִיד מַחֲצִיתָהּ בַּבֹּקֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָהּ בָּעָרֶב׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		“This is the offering of Aaron and his sons that they
		shall bring to YHWH in the day of his being anointed: a
		tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a continual grain
		offering, half of it in the morning and half of it in the
		evening.
	}

verses.original: עַל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: It shall be made on a griddle in oil. You shall bring it well mixed. You shall offer it as cakes of a grain offering of pieces, a pleasant smell to YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{עַל מַחֲבַת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה מֻרְבֶּכֶת תְּבִיאֶנָּה תֻּפִינֵי מִנְחַת פִּתִּים תַּקְרִיב רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ לַיהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חק עוֹלָם לַיהֹוָה כָּלִיל תּקְטָר׃
verses.english: And the anointed priest in his place from among his sons shall do it, an eternal law, for YHWH: it shall be burned to smoke entirely.

tex.original: \hP{וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמָּשִׁיחַ תַּחְתָּיו מִבָּנָיו יַעֲשֶׂה אֹתָהּ חק עוֹלָם לַיהֹוָה כָּלִיל תּקְטָר׃}

verses.original: וְכל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃
verses.english: And every grain offering of a priest shall be done entirely. It shall not be eaten.”

tex.original: \hP{וְכל מִנְחַת כֹּהֵן כָּלִיל תִּהְיֶה לֹא תֵאָכֵל׃}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשָּׁחֵט הָעֹלָה תִּשָּׁחֵט הַחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃
verses.english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the instruction for the sin offering. In the place where the burnt offering will be slaughtered, the sin offering shall be slaughtered, in front of YHWH. It is the holy of holies.

tex.original: \hP{דַּבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר זֹאת תּוֹרַת הַחַטָּאת בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר תִּשָּׁחֵט הָעֹלָה תִּשָּׁחֵט הַחַטָּאת לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		“Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: This is the
		instruction for the sin offering. In the place where the
		burnt offering will be slaughtered, the sin offering shall
		be slaughtered, in front of YHWH. It is the holy of
		holies.
	}

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵן הַמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכְלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃
verses.english: The priest who makes it a sin offering shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

tex.original: \hP{הַכֹּהֵן הַמְחַטֵּא אֹתָהּ יֹאכְלֶנָּה בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ תֵּאָכֵל בַּחֲצַר אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃}

verses.original: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃
verses.english: Anything that will touch the meat of it will become holy. And if some of its blood will spatter on clothing, you shall wash the thing on which it will spatter in a holy place.

tex.original: \hP{כֹּל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בִּבְשָׂרָהּ יִקְדָּשׁ וַאֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה מִדָּמָהּ עַל הַבֶּגֶד אֲשֶׁר יִזֶּה עָלֶיהָ תְּכַבֵּס בְּמָקוֹם קָדֹשׁ׃}

verses.original: וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּיִם׃
verses.english: And a clay container in which it will be boiled shall be broken. And if it was boiled in a brass container then it shall be scoured and rinsed with water.

tex.original: \hP{וּכְלִי חֶרֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּוֹ יִשָּׁבֵר וְאִם בִּכְלִי נְחֹשֶׁת בֻּשָּׁלָה וּמֹרַק וְשֻׁטַּף בַּמָּיִם׃}

verses.original: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃
verses.english: Every male among the priests shall eat it. It is the holy of holies.

tex.original: \hP{כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכַל אֹתָהּ קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הִוא׃}

verses.original: וְכל חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יוּבָא מִדָּמָהּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ לֹא תֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃
verses.english: And every sin offering some of whose blood will be brought to the Tent of Meeting for atoning in the Holy shall not be eaten. It shall be burned in fire.

tex.original: \hP{וְכל חַטָּאת אֲשֶׁר יוּבָא מִדָּמָהּ אֶל אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד לְכַפֵּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ לֹא תֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ תִּשָּׂרֵף׃}

verses.original: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃
verses.english: “And this is the instruction for the guilt offering. It is the holy of holies.

tex.original: \hP{וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת הָאָשָׁם קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃}

verses.original: בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָעֹלָה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃
verses.english: They shall slaughter the guilt offering in the place where they slaughter the burnt offering. And he shall fling its blood on the altar all around.

tex.original: \hP{בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָעֹלָה יִשְׁחֲטוּ אֶת הָאָשָׁם וְאֶת דָּמוֹ יִזְרֹק עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃}

verses.original: וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב׃
verses.english: And he shall bring forward from it all its fat, the fat tail and the fat that covers the innards,

tex.original: \hP{וְאֵת כּל חֶלְבּוֹ יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֵת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמְכַסֶּה אֶת הַקֶּרֶב׃}

verses.original: וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃
verses.english: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that is on the loins; and the lobe on the liver: he shall take it away with the kidneys.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֵת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עֲלֵיהֶן אֲשֶׁר עַל הַכְּסָלִים וְאֶת הַיֹּתֶרֶת עַל הַכָּבֵד עַל הַכְּלָיֹת יְסִירֶנָּה׃}

verses.original: וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אָשָׁם הוּא׃
verses.english: And the priest shall burn them to smoke at the altar, an offering by fire to YHWH. It is a guilt offering.

tex.original: \hP{וְהִקְטִיר אֹתָם הַכֹּהֵן הַמִּזְבֵּחָה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה אָשָׁם הוּא׃}

verses.original: כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃
verses.english: Every male among the priests shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is the holy of holies.

tex.original: \hP{כּל זָכָר בַּכֹּהֲנִים יֹאכְלֶנּוּ בְּמָקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יֵאָכֵל קֹדֶשׁ קדָשִׁים הוּא׃}

verses.original: כַּחַטָּאת כָּאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃
verses.english: As with the sin offering, so with the guilt offering: they have one instruction. The priest who will make atonement with it: it shall be his.

tex.original: \hP{כַּחַטָּאת כָּאָשָׁם תּוֹרָה אַחַת לָהֶם הַכֹּהֵן אֲשֶׁר יְכַפֶּר בּוֹ לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃}

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת עֹלַת אִישׁ עוֹר הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃
verses.english: And the priest who brings forward a man’s burnt offering: the skin of the burnt offering that he brought forward is for the priest; it shall be his.

tex.original: \hP{וְהַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת עֹלַת אִישׁ עוֹר הָעֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לַכֹּהֵן לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃}

verses.original: וְכל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃
verses.english: And every grain offering that will be baked in an oven and every one made in a pan and on a griddle shall be for the priest who brings it; it shall be his.

tex.original: \hP{וְכל מִנְחָה אֲשֶׁר תֵּאָפֶה בַּתַּנּוּר וְכל נַעֲשָׂה בַמַּרְחֶשֶׁת וְעַל מַחֲבַת לַכֹּהֵן הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתָהּ לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃}

verses.original: וְכל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו׃
verses.english: And every grain offering mixed with oil or dry shall be for all the sons of Aaron, each like his brother.

tex.original: \hP{וְכל מִנְחָה בְלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וַחֲרֵבָה לְכל בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן תִּהְיֶה אִישׁ כְּאָחִיו׃}

verses.original: וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: “And this is the instruction of the peace-offering sacrifice that one shall bring forward to YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{וְזֹאת תּוֹרַת זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב לַיהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: אִם עַל תּוֹדָה יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ וְהִקְרִיב עַל זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה חַלּוֹת מַצּוֹת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וְסֹלֶת מֻרְבֶּכֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשָּׁמֶן׃
verses.english: If he will bring it forward out of thanks then he shall bring forward with the sacrifice of thanks unleavened cakes mixed with oil and unleavened wafers with oil poured on them and fine flour well mixed, cakes, mixed with oil.

tex.original: \hP{אִם עַל תּוֹדָה יַקְרִיבֶנּוּ וְהִקְרִיב עַל זֶבַח הַתּוֹדָה חַלּוֹת מַצּוֹת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשֶּׁמֶן וּרְקִיקֵי מַצּוֹת מְשֻׁחִים בַּשָּׁמֶן וְסֹלֶת מֻרְבֶּכֶת חַלֹּת בְּלוּלֹת בַּשָּׁמֶן׃}

verses.original: עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו׃
verses.english: He shall make his offering with cakes of leavened bread, with his peace-offering sacrifice of thanks.

tex.original: \hP{עַל חַלֹּת לֶחֶם חָמֵץ יַקְרִיב קרְבָּנוֹ עַל זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו׃}

verses.original: וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכּל קרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃
verses.english: And he shall bring forward from it one of each offering as a donation for YHWH. For the priest who flings the blood of the peace offerings: it shall be his.

tex.original: \hP{וְהִקְרִיב מִמֶּנּוּ אֶחָד מִכּל קרְבָּן תְּרוּמָה לַיהֹוָה לַכֹּהֵן הַזֹּרֵק אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים לוֹ יִהְיֶה׃}

verses.original: וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃
verses.english: And the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until morning.

tex.original: \hP{וּבְשַׂר זֶבַח תּוֹדַת שְׁלָמָיו בְּיוֹם קרְבָּנוֹ יֵאָכֵל לֹא יַנִּיחַ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד בֹּקֶר׃}

verses.original: וְאִם נֶדֶר אוֹ נְדָבָה זֶבַח קרְבָּנוֹ בְּיוֹם הַקְרִיבוֹ אֶת זִבְחוֹ יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר מִמֶּנּוּ יֵאָכֵל׃
verses.english: And if his sacrificial offering is a vow or a contribution, it shall be eaten on the day that he brings forward his sacrifice, and on the next day what is left of it may be eaten.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם נֶדֶר אוֹ נְדָבָה זֶבַח קרְבָּנוֹ בְּיוֹם הַקְרִיבוֹ אֶת זִבְחוֹ יֵאָכֵל וּמִמּחֳרָת וְהַנּוֹתָר מִמֶּנּוּ יֵאָכֵל׃}

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃
verses.english: And what is left of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned in fire.

tex.original: \hP{וְהַנּוֹתָר מִבְּשַׂר הַזָּבַח בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף׃}

verses.original: וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֹא יֵרָצֶה הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁב לוֹ פִּגּוּל יִהְיֶה וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מִמֶּנּוּ עֲוֺנָהּ תִּשָּׂא׃
verses.english: And if any of the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice will be eaten on the third day, it shall not be acceptable. The one who brings it forward: it shall not be counted for him. It shall be a repugnant thing. And the person who eats any of it shall bear his crime.

tex.original: \hP{וְאִם הֵאָכֹל יֵאָכֵל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי לֹא יֵרָצֶה הַמַּקְרִיב אֹתוֹ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁב לוֹ פִּגּוּל יִהְיֶה וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מִמֶּנּוּ עֲוֺנָהּ תִּשָּׂא׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		And if any of the meat of his peace-offering sacrifice
		will be eaten on the third day, it shall not be
		acceptable. The one who brings it forward: it shall not be
		counted for him. It shall be a repugnant thing. And the
		person who eats any of it shall bear his crime.
	}

verses.original: וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף וְהַבָּשָׂר כּל טָהוֹר יֹאכַל בָּשָׂר׃
verses.english: And meat that will touch any impure thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned in fire. And meat: everyone who is pure may eat meat,

tex.original: \hP{וְהַבָּשָׂר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא לֹא יֵאָכֵל בָּאֵשׁ יִשָּׂרֵף וְהַבָּשָׂר כּל טָהוֹר יֹאכַל בָּשָׂר׃}

verses.original: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: but the person who will eat meat from the peace-offering sacrifice that is YHWH’s while his impurity is on him, that person will be cut off from his people.

tex.original: \hP{וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל בָּשָׂר מִזֶּבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְטֻמְאָתוֹ עָלָיו וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃}

verses.original: וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם אוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּכל שֶׁקֶץ טָמֵא וְאָכַל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: And a person who will touch any impure thing, human impurity or an impure animal or any impure detestable thing, and will eat some of the meat of the peace-offering sacrifice that is YHWH’s: that person will be cut off from his people.”

tex.original: \hP{וְנֶפֶשׁ כִּי תִגַּע בְּכל טָמֵא בְּטֻמְאַת אָדָם אוֹ בִּבְהֵמָה טְמֵאָה אוֹ בְּכל שֶׁקֶץ טָמֵא וְאָכַל מִבְּשַׂר זֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים אֲשֶׁר לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		And a person who will touch any impure thing, human
		impurity or an impure animal or any impure detestable
		thing, and will eat some of the meat of the peace-offering
		sacrifice that is YHWH’s: that person will be cut off from
		his people.”
	}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃
verses.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying: You shall not eat any fat of an ox or sheep or goat.

tex.original: \hP{דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר כּל חֵלֶב שׁוֹר וְכֶשֶׂב וָעֵז לֹא תֹאכֵלוּ׃}

verses.original: וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻהוּ׃
verses.english: And fat of a carcass and fat of a torn animal may be used for any work, but you shall not eat it.

tex.original: \hP{וְחֵלֶב נְבֵלָה וְחֵלֶב טְרֵפָה יֵעָשֶׂה לְכל מְלָאכָה וְאָכֹל לֹא תֹאכְלֻהוּ׃}

verses.original: כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חֵלֶב מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנָּה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: Because anyone who eats fat from an animal from which one would bring forward an offering by fire to YHWH, the person who eats it will be cut off from his people.

tex.original: \hP{כִּי כּל אֹכֵל חֵלֶב מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִיב מִמֶּנָּה אִשֶּׁה לַיהֹוָה וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הָאֹכֶלֶת מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃}

verses.original: וְכל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָה׃
verses.english: And you shall not eat any blood in all of your homes, a bird’s or an animal’s.

tex.original: \hP{וְכל דָּם לֹא תֹאכְלוּ בְּכֹל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶם לָעוֹף וְלַבְּהֵמָה׃}

verses.original: כּל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל כּל דָּם וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: Any person who will eat any blood, that person will be cut off from his people.”

tex.original: \hP{כּל נֶפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַל כּל דָּם וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ׃}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו לַיהֹוָה יָבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִזֶּבַח שְׁלָמָיו׃
verses.english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying: The one who brings forward his peace-offering sacrifice to YHWH shall bring his offering to YHWH from his peace-offering sacrifice:

tex.original: \hP{דַּבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת זֶבַח שְׁלָמָיו לַיהֹוָה יָבִיא אֶת קרְבָּנוֹ לַיהֹוָה מִזֶּבַח שְׁלָמָיו׃}

verses.original: יָדָיו תְּבִיאֶינָה אֵת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב עַל הֶחָזֶה יְבִיאֶנּוּ אֵת הֶחָזֶה לְהָנִיף אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃
verses.english: his hands shall bring YHWH’s offerings by fire. He shall bring it, the fat with the breast: the breast so as to elevate it, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{יָדָיו תְּבִיאֶינָה אֵת אִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה אֶת הַחֵלֶב עַל הֶחָזֶה יְבִיאֶנּוּ אֵת הֶחָזֶה לְהָנִיף אֹתוֹ תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃
verses.english: And the priest shall burn the fat to smoke at the altar, and the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

tex.original: \hP{וְהִקְטִיר הַכֹּהֵן אֶת הַחֵלֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחָה וְהָיָה הֶחָזֶה לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְבָנָיו׃}

verses.original: וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: And you shall give the right thigh as a donation to the priest from your peace-offering sacrifices.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין תִּתְּנוּ תְרוּמָה לַכֹּהֵן מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיכֶם׃}

verses.original: הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָה׃
verses.english: The one from the sons of Aaron who brings forward the blood of the peace offerings and the fat: the right thigh shall be his as a portion.

tex.original: \hP{הַמַּקְרִיב אֶת דַּם הַשְּׁלָמִים וְאֶת הַחֵלֶב מִבְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן לוֹ תִהְיֶה שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין לְמָנָה׃}

verses.original: כִּי אֶת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה לָקַחְתִּי מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן אֹתָם לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Because I have taken the breast of the elevation offering and the thigh of the donation from the children of Israel, from their peace-offering sacrifices, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal law from the children of Israel.”

tex.original: \hP{כִּי אֶת חֲזֵה הַתְּנוּפָה וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַתְּרוּמָה לָקַחְתִּי מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִזִּבְחֵי שַׁלְמֵיהֶם וָאֶתֵּן אֹתָם לְאַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן וּלְבָנָיו לְחק עוֹלָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃}
tex.english:
\eP{
		Because I have taken the breast of the elevation offering
		and the thigh of the donation from the children of Israel,
		from their peace-offering sacrifices, and I have given
		them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal law
		from the children of Israel.”
	}

verses.original: זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his sons from YHWH’s offerings by fire in the day He brought them forward to function as priests for YHWH,

tex.original: \hP{זֹאת מִשְׁחַת אַהֲרֹן וּמִשְׁחַת בָּנָיו מֵאִשֵּׁי יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם הִקְרִיב אֹתָם לְכַהֵן לַיהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לָהֶם בְּיוֹם משְׁחוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃
verses.english: which YHWH commanded to give to them in the day of His anointing them from among the children of Israel, an eternal law through their generations.

tex.original: \hP{אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לָתֵת לָהֶם בְּיוֹם משְׁחוֹ אֹתָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל חֻקַּת עוֹלָם לְדֹרֹתָם׃}

verses.original: זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃
verses.english: This is the instruction of the burnt offering, of the grain offering, and of the sin offering and of the guilt offering and of the ordination and of the peace-offering sacrifice,

tex.original: \hP{זֹאת הַתּוֹרָה לָעֹלָה לַמִּנְחָה וְלַחַטָּאת וְלָאָשָׁם וְלַמִּלּוּאִים וּלְזֶבַח הַשְּׁלָמִים׃}
tex.commentary:
%	\footnote{
%		This is the instruction of the burnt offering … This concludes seven
%		chapters of laws about sacrifices. Because it has been nearly two
%		millennia since the Temple sacrifices ended, what can substitute for
%		sacrifice as something that can give people some of the things that
%		sacrifices provided: a feeling of fulfillment, closeness to God,
%		sacredness of life, a link to Israel’s history? My friend Rabbi Lawson
%		says: charity. A parallel question: what can substitute for ancestor
%		veneration, which was well known in the biblical world? Lawson says:
%		charity in memory of persons who have died. Many would say that we have
%		prayer as well as charity to compensate for the lack of sacrifice. And
%		we have other acts of atonement, such as fasting. All of this may be
%		true, but I note that people had prayer and charity and fasting in
%		biblical times, too. So these are not replacements for sacrifice. They
%		existed beside sacrifice all along. My question is: what do we have now
%		that they did not have? Answer: study. What we have that no one in the
%		biblical world (until Ezra) had is: the Torah. What we have that no one
%		at all in biblical times had is the full Tanak. Our task is to study it,
%		to shine our own new light on it, and to shine its light on us. This is
%		our task individually, in groups, and as a community.
%	}

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי בְּיוֹם צַוֺּתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבְּנֵיהֶם לַיהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃
verses.english: which YHWH commanded Moses in Mount Sinai in the day that He commanded the children of Israel to make their offerings to YHWH in the wilderness of Sinai.

tex.original: \hP{אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה בְּהַר סִינָי בְּיוֹם צַוֺּתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַקְרִיב אֶת קרְבְּנֵיהֶם לַיהֹוָה בְּמִדְבַּר סִינָי׃}

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃
verses.english: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

tex.original: \hP{וַיְדַבֵּר יְהֹוָה אֶל מֹשֶׁה לֵּאמֹר׃}
tex.english: \eP{And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,}

verses.original: קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּוֹת׃
verses.english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him and the clothes and the anointing oil and the bull for the sin offering and the two rams and the basket of unleavened bread,

tex.original: \hP{קַח אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו אִתּוֹ וְאֵת הַבְּגָדִים וְאֵת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וְאֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וְאֵת שְׁנֵי הָאֵילִים וְאֵת סַל הַמַּצּוֹת׃}
tex.commentary:
%	\footnote{
%		Take Aaron and his sons. Leviticus has only two narrative accounts. The
%		first is the story of the consecration of Aaron and his sons to the
%		priesthood of Israel (Leviticus 8–10). It is a lengthy and detailed
%		account. Most of the ceremonies that it describes have already been
%		presented in Exodus 29 as commands that YHWH gives to Moses, and now the
%		fulfillment of these commands is narrated. The details of the rituals
%		are impressive, picturing Moses placing the priestly garments one by one
%		on Aaron, then picturing him anointing, first, the Tabernacle and its
%		contents, then the altar, then Aaron. Next he has Aaron’s sons clothed.
%		Then the inaugural sacrifices of the priesthood are described, with
%		details of Moses’ slaughtering of a bull and two rams and his dabbing of
%		their blood on the altar and on the right ears, thumbs, and big toes of
%		Aaron and his sons. Moses directs Aaron and his sons to eat the
%		sacrificial meat at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, from which they
%		are not permitted to depart for seven days. On the eighth day, another
%		series of sacrifices is pictured, but it is no longer Moses who performs
%		them, but rather Aaron and his sons. Then Aaron blesses the people and,
%		for the first time, enters the Tent of Meeting alongside Moses. When
%		they come out, they bless the people together, the glory of YHWH appears
%		to the people, divine fire comes and consumes the offering, and the
%		people shout and fall to the ground.
%	}

verses.original: וְאֵת כּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃
verses.english: and assemble all of the congregation to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.”

tex.original: \hP{וְאֵת כּל הָעֵדָה הַקְהֵל אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃}

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃
verses.english: And Moses did as YHWH commanded him. And the congregation was gathered to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּעַשׂ מֹשֶׁה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֹתוֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל הָעֵדָה אֶל פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד׃}

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
verses.english: And Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing that YHWH has commanded to do.”

tex.original: \hP{וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל הָעֵדָה זֶה הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת׃}

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃
verses.english: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and he washed them with water.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת אַהֲרֹן וְאֶת בָּנָיו וַיִּרְחַץ אֹתָם בַּמָּיִם׃}

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בָּאַבְנֵט וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ אֶת הַמְּעִיל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הָאֵפֹד וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וַיֶּאְפֹּד לוֹ בּוֹ׃
verses.english: And he put the coat on him and belted him with the sash and dressed him with the robe and put the ephod on him and belted him with the ephod’s designed belt and put on the ephod for him with it.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הַכֻּתֹּנֶת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בָּאַבְנֵט וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ אֶת הַמְּעִיל וַיִּתֵּן עָלָיו אֶת הָאֵפֹד וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתוֹ בְּחֵשֶׁב הָאֵפֹד וַיֶּאְפֹּד לוֹ בּוֹ׃}

verses.original: וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים׃
verses.english: And he set the breastplate on him and put the Urim and Tummim into the breastplate.

tex.original: \hP{וַיָּשֶׂם עָלָיו אֶת הַחֹשֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן אֶל הַחֹשֶׁן אֶת הָאוּרִים וְאֶת הַתֻּמִּים׃}

verses.original: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו אֵת צִיץ הַזָּהָב נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: And he set the headdress on his head and set the gold plate, the crown of Holiness, on the headdress opposite the front of it, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת הַמִּצְנֶפֶת עַל רֹאשׁוֹ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַמִּצְנֶפֶת אֶל מוּל פָּנָיו אֵת צִיץ הַזָּהָב נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃
verses.english: And Moses took the anointing oil, and he anointed the Tabernacle and everything that was in it, so he consecrated them.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת שֶׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּשְׁכָּן וְאֶת כּל אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתָם׃}

verses.original: וַיַּז מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ לְקַדְּשָׁם׃
verses.english: And he sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times and anointed the altar and all of its equipment and the basin and its stand to consecrate them.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּז מִמֶּנּוּ עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים וַיִּמְשַׁח אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת כּל כֵּלָיו וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּר וְאֶת כַּנּוֹ לְקַדְּשָׁם׃}

verses.original: וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: And he poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּצֹק מִשֶּׁמֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה עַל רֹאשׁ אַהֲרֹן וַיִּמְשַׁח אֹתוֹ לְקַדְּשׁוֹ׃}

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: And Moses brought forward Aaron’s sons and dressed them in coats and belted them with a sash and put on hats for them, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּקְרֵב מֹשֶׁה אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁם כֻּתֳּנֹת וַיַּחְגֹּר אֹתָם אַבְנֵט וַיַּחֲבֹשׁ לָהֶם מִגְבָּעוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וַיִּסְמֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ פַּר הַחַטָּאת׃
verses.english: And he brought up the bull for the sin offering. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull for the sin offering.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּגֵּשׁ אֵת פַּר הַחַטָּאת וַיִּסְמֹךְ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ פַּר הַחַטָּאת׃}

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וַיְחַטֵּא אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃
verses.english: And Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and put it on the altar’s horns all around with his finger and purified the altar from sin, and he poured the blood at the base of the altar, and he consecrated it to make atonement on it.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם וַיִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וַיְחַטֵּא אֶת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְאֶת הַדָּם יָצַק אֶל יְסוֹד הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ לְכַפֵּר עָלָיו׃}

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃
verses.english: And he took all the fat that was on the innards and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses burned them to smoke at the altar.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּקַּח אֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה הַמִּזְבֵּחָה׃}

verses.original: וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: And he burned the bull and its skin and its meat and its dung in fire outside the camp, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֶת הַפָּר וְאֶת עֹרוֹ וְאֶת בְּשָׂרוֹ וְאֶת פִּרְשׁוֹ שָׂרַף בָּאֵשׁ מִחוּץ לַמַּחֲנֶה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת אֵיל הָעֹלָה וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃
verses.english: And he brought forward the ram for the burnt offering. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּקְרֵב אֵת אֵיל הָעֹלָה וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃}

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃
verses.english: And he slaughtered it, and Moses flung the blood on the altar all around.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃}

verses.original: וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר׃
verses.english: And he cut the ram into its parts, and Moses burned the head and the parts and the suet to smoke.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֶת הָאַיִל נִתַּח לִנְתָחָיו וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת הָרֹאשׁ וְאֶת הַנְּתָחִים וְאֶת הַפָּדֶר׃}

verses.original: וְאֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַיִם רָחַץ בַּמָּיִם וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: And he washed the innards and the legs with water. And Moses burned all of the ram to smoke at the altar. It was a burnt offering as a pleasant smell. It was an offering by fire to YHWH, as YHWH had commanded Moses.

tex.original: \hP{וְאֶת הַקֶּרֶב וְאֶת הַכְּרָעַיִם רָחַץ בַּמָּיִם וַיַּקְטֵר מֹשֶׁה אֶת כּל הָאַיִל הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עֹלָה הוּא לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃}

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃
verses.english: And he brought forward the second ram, the ram of ordination. And Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the ram’s head.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת הָאַיִל הַשֵּׁנִי אֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים וַיִּסְמְכוּ אַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת יְדֵיהֶם עַל רֹאשׁ הָאָיִל׃}

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃
verses.english: And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּשְׁחָט וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה מִדָּמוֹ וַיִּתֵּן עַל תְּנוּךְ אֹזֶן אַהֲרֹן הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדוֹ הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלוֹ הַיְמָנִית׃}

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה מִן הַדָּם עַל תְּנוּךְ אזְנָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃
verses.english: And he brought Aaron’s sons forward, and Moses put some of the blood on their right earlobe and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot. And Moses flung the blood on the altar all around.

tex.original: \hP{וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וַיִּתֵּן מֹשֶׁה מִן הַדָּם עַל תְּנוּךְ אזְנָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן יָדָם הַיְמָנִית וְעַל בֹּהֶן רַגְלָם הַיְמָנִית וַיִּזְרֹק מֹשֶׁה אֶת הַדָּם עַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ סָבִיב׃}

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃
verses.english: And he took the fat and the fat tail and all the fat that was on the innards and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּקַּח אֶת הַחֵלֶב וְאֶת הָאַלְיָה וְאֶת כּל הַחֵלֶב אֲשֶׁר עַל הַקֶּרֶב וְאֵת יֹתֶרֶת הַכָּבֵד וְאֶת שְׁתֵּי הַכְּלָיֹת וְאֶת חֶלְבְּהֶן וְאֵת שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃}

verses.original: וּמִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָקַח חַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַחֲלָבִים וְעַל שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃
verses.english: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was in front of YHWH he took one cake of unleavened bread and one cake of bread with oil and one wafer, and he set them on the fats and on the right thigh.

tex.original: \hP{וּמִסַּל הַמַּצּוֹת אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לָקַח חַלַּת מַצָּה אַחַת וְחַלַּת לֶחֶם שֶׁמֶן אַחַת וְרָקִיק אֶחָד וַיָּשֶׂם עַל הַחֲלָבִים וְעַל שׁוֹק הַיָּמִין׃}

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃
verses.english: And he put it all on Aaron’s hands and on his sons’ hands and elevated them, an elevation offering in front of YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּתֵּן אֶת הַכֹּל עַל כַּפֵּי אַהֲרֹן וְעַל כַּפֵּי בָנָיו וַיָּנֶף אֹתָם תְּנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֹתָם מֵעַל כַּפֵּיהֶם וַיַּקְטֵר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה מִלֻּאִים הֵם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃
verses.english: And Moses took them from on their hands and burned them to smoke at the altar with the burnt offering. They were an ordination offering as a pleasant smell. It was an offering by fire to YHWH.

tex.original: \hP{וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֹתָם מֵעַל כַּפֵּיהֶם וַיַּקְטֵר הַמִּזְבֵּחָה עַל הָעֹלָה מִלֻּאִים הֵם לְרֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ אִשֶּׁה הוּא לַיהֹוָה׃}

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח מֹשֶׁה אֶת הֶחָזֶה וַיְנִיפֵהוּ תְנוּפָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה מֵאֵיל הַמִּלֻּאִים לְמֹשֶׁה הָיָה לְמָנָה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְהֹוָה אֶת מֹשֶׁה׃
